brief: Big gambrel horse and cattle barn about 40 ft wide and 70 ft long in faded barn-red drop siding with white trim, crowned by a bright forest-green standing-seam metal gambrel roof. The gable end has a centered white sliding door, a white hay door and a round-arched white loft door above it, a louvered arched vent at the peak and small white-framed windows. A long lower red wing with its own green roof and white sliding door runs off one side. Pole and plank corrals, a windmill and ponderosa pines of the Pine Ridge around.
